heroHeadline: Madrid Residency Midpoint — 256,000+ Fans Through Four Sold-Out Nights; "DtMF" Hits 62nd Week at No. 1
heroSubtitle: Bad Bunny's 10-night residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano in Madrid is at its midpoint. Four sold-out shows — Nights 1–4 (May 30, 31, June 2, 3) — have drawn 256,000+ fans. Each night delivered an exclusive guest: Night 1, the first-ever live collaboration with Myke Towers ('Adivino' + medley); Night 2, Luar La L performed 'Teléfono Nuevo' from La Casita; Night 3, Young Miko climbed La Casita for 'FINA' plus three solo tracks; Night 4 brought Spanish cinema royalty — Penélope Cruz (her second visit), Mónica Cruz, Luis Tosar, and Óscar Jaenada — as VIP guests. Night 5 opens the third cluster on June 6. Meanwhile, the Billboard Hot Latin Songs chart dated June 6, 2026 confirms 'DtMF' at No. 1 for its 62nd consecutive week — extending the all-time record it broke at week 57 when it surpassed 'Despacito.' Spotify monthly listeners hold above 114M on sustained Madrid tour momentum. The Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour continues: Düsseldorf (June 20–21), Arnhem (June 23–24), London's Tottenham Hotspur Stadium (June 27–28 — first-ever UK stadium dates), and Brussels (July 22). Additionally, Bad Bunny voices 'Pizza with Sunglasses' in Pixar's Toy Story 5, releasing June 19, 2026.
